reconstruction_diagnosis.rationale: Reconstruction fully covers supplier onboarding and proposal management.

decisions.rationale: The parent is source-supported and represents an independent outcome.
decisions.outcome_justification: Supplier registers, submits proposals, and receives feedback; no other HLG covers this end-to-end process.

reconstruction_diagnosis.rationale: Reconstruction omits administrator tools for proposal evaluation and revisions.

decisions.rationale: The source describes administrator tools beyond automatic rejection.
decisions.outcome_justification: Administrator evaluates proposals, requests revisions, and manages delays; the parent should reflect this broader responsibility.
decisions.rewriting_focus: Expand to include proposal evaluation, revision requests, and performance tracking for administrators.

reconstruction_diagnosis.rationale: Reconstruction accurately reflects inventory management capabilities.

decisions.rationale: The parent is source-supported and distinct from other administrator goals.
decisions.outcome_justification: Administrator manages real-time inventory, reorders, and replenishment; no overlap with other HLGs.

reconstruction_diagnosis.rationale: Reconstruction matches goods receiving and store placement workflow.

decisions.rationale: The parent is source-supported and serves a unique staff outcome.
decisions.outcome_justification: Goods-Receiving Staff verifies, assigns, and flags products; no other HLG covers this process.

reconstruction_diagnosis.rationale: Reconstruction conflates order fulfillment with proposal evaluation.

decisions.rationale: The parent over-specifies internal workflow steps without a distinct outcome.
decisions.outcome_justification: Order processing is part of broader supplier management; the containing outcome is managing supplier proposals and payments.

reconstruction_diagnosis.rationale: Reconstruction fully captures online shopping and payment experience.

decisions.rationale: The parent is source-supported and represents a distinct customer outcome.
decisions.outcome_justification: Customer browses, purchases, and tracks orders; no other HLG covers this end-to-end process.

reconstruction_diagnosis.rationale: Reconstruction accurately reflects support ticket management.

decisions.rationale: The parent is source-supported and serves a unique agent outcome.
decisions.outcome_justification: Customer-Service Agent manages tickets, responses, and performance; no overlap with other HLGs.

reconstruction_diagnosis.rationale: Reconstruction omits strategic decision-making and focuses on report generation.

decisions.rationale: The source describes broader business analysis beyond reports.
decisions.outcome_justification: Administrator analyzes data for strategic decisions; the parent should reflect this higher-level outcome.
decisions.rewriting_focus: Expand to include data collection, analysis, and decision support for management.
